# QPDF WebAssembly runtime

Unmodified `qpdf.js` and `qpdf.wasm` from the npm registry package
`@neslinesli93/qpdf-wasm` **0.3.0**.

- Wrapper source: https://github.com/neslinesli93/qpdf-wasm
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@neslinesli93/qpdf-wasm/v/0.3.0
- Package metadata declares ISC licensing for its wrapper.
- QPDF source and license: https://github.com/qpdf/qpdf
- QPDF has used Apache License 2.0 since version 7.0.
- QPDF's copyright and license notice is included alongside this file
  in `COPYRIGHT.txt` (reported by the bundled engine itself).

These assets are served locally and run in a dedicated browser worker. No PDF
bytes or passwords are sent to a server. The worker is terminated after each
unlock operation.
